speech._clientsNote: Language layer (B-18/X-05, docs/agent/LANGUAGE_LAYER.md). REST clients by id; every one ships DISABLED with ${PLACEHOLDER} endpoints and keys that resolve from local.properties SPEECH_* entries (never committed). To turn one on: put its SPEECH_* values in local.properties, set enabled=true, then list its id under providers.speech.asr.online.<lang> / tts.<role> (models.json) or mt.<direction> (below). A client that is disabled, missing a key or not https is never built, so routing falls through to the on-device engines.

hcilab_asr._note: UG HCI Lab (University of Ghana) speech recognition — REQUIRED for Twi once the lab issues access. The request/response shape here is a PLACEHOLDER (multipart file + language field, JSON {"text"}); copy the real field names from the lab's API docs. local.properties: SPEECH_HCILAB_ASR_URL, SPEECH_HCILAB_KEY.

hcilab_tts._note: UG HCI Lab Twi voice. PLACEHOLDER shape: JSON {"text", "language"} in, audio bytes out. local.properties: SPEECH_HCILAB_TTS_URL, SPEECH_HCILAB_KEY.

hcilab_mt._note: UG HCI Lab translation, if offered. PLACEHOLDER shape: JSON {"text", "source", "target"} in, JSON {"translation"} out. local.properties: SPEECH_HCILAB_MT_URL, SPEECH_HCILAB_KEY.

openai_asr._note: Any OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions server, e.g. a hosted Ghanaian-English Whisper tune. Ghanaian English ONLY (Whisper has no Twi token) — list it under asr.online.gh_en, never twi or auto. Reuses the existing local.properties slots ASR_ONLINE_URL (…/v1), ASR_ONLINE_KEY, ASR_ONLINE_MODEL.

mt._note: Translator ids per direction, tried in order. enToTwi localizes English replies for a Twi speaker (ReplyLocalizer: never text with numbers/money, names must survive, else the original is spoken). twiToEn is exposed for the agent (LanguageLayer.translator) but not wired into the loop.

language._note: B-05 LanguageSession: replies follow the language of the user's last turn while the conversation is live (conversationTtlSec); the persisted habitual language (the low-signal fallback after a pause) changes only after habitualSwitchTurns turns in a row in the other language.
